work_experience.title: Senior Technical Project Manager / Scrum Master / Delivery Manager

projects.name: Virtual App Store
details: Domain: Assurance / Legal & Compliance Technology
• Lead end-to-end Agile delivery for EY Neo POD supporting a legal and compliance platform focused on digital
transformation, anomaly detection, and regulatory compliance.
• Manage one Agile POD of 14 cross-functional team members within an overall 70+ member program,
coordinating delivery across multiple geographies and time zones.
• Drive quarterly release planning and execution, ensuring alignment of sprint goals, milestone commitments, and
stakeholder expectations across distributed teams.
• Improved delivery turnaround time by strengthening sprint execution, backlog readiness, dependency tracking,
and release governance.
• Oversee project financial operations for a Multi million $ engagement, including budgeting, costing, revenue
tracking, margin monitoring, forecasting, and invoicing.
• Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews,
Retrospectives, and stakeholder demos to maintain delivery cadence and team alignment.
• Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, and engineering teams to prioritize roadmap items,
refine features and user stories, and align delivery with business objectives.
• Drive delivery visibility and governance through Azure DevOps dashboards, velocity tracking, burndown
reporting, defect monitoring, and executive status reporting.
• Support PI planning, capacity planning, risk/issue management, dependency management, and quarterly
business reviews to improve predictability and stakeholder confidence.
• Enabled faster release cycles and continuous flow of changes through adoption of a Continuous Delivery Pipeline
(CDP) and disciplined Agile delivery practices.
• Lead people management activities including hiring support, onboarding/offboarding, mentoring, performance
feedback, career discussions, and conflict resolution.
• Ensure adherence to Agile best practices, Scrum principles, and organizational delivery governance standards
while supporting high-quality, predictable client delivery.
Environment: Azure DevOps, Aha!, .NET, Angular, Azure App Services, Microservices, CI/CD
CAPGEMINI INDIA PVT. LTD. – Pune, India

projects.name: Payments Orchestration Layer
projects.client: HSBC | Domain: Banking Payments | Duration: Jan 2021 – Jan 2022
details: • Led Agile POD delivery across Hong Kong, Singapore, and Thailand for a payments orchestration platform
supporting MVP milestones aligned to ISO 20022 adoption.
• Facilitated Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and daily
stand-ups to ensure smooth sprint execution and alignment with release objectives.
• Worked on payment orchestration initiatives supporting SWIFT payment flows and ISO 20022
migration for HSBC Payments platforms.
• Managed backlog planning, sprint tracking, delivery reporting, and Agile metrics using Jira and Confluence to improve delivery visibility and governance.
• Monitored velocity, burndown, defect trends, and backlog health to improve sprint predictability, transparency,
and release readiness.
• Coordinated cross-POD planning, stakeholder demos, and knowledge-sharing sessions across distributed teams
and business stakeholders.
• Tracked and mitigated risks, issues, and dependencies through RAID management and proactive stakeholder
follow-ups.
Environment: Jira, Confluence, Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, Kafka, Oracle, Git, Jenkins, Postman, REST APIs

projects.name: Large Corporate Receivable Finance
projects.client: HSBC | Domain: Commercial Banking | Duration: Oct 2018 – Dec 2020
details: • Served as Scrum Master for a 20-member Agile team delivering a Straight-Through Processing (STP) solution for
supplier invoice and credit note processing via HSBCNet.
• Drove Agile Scrum adoption and coordinated delivery across Business, Transformation, and Technology teams to support milestone execution and business objectives.
• Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives while
partnering with the Product Owner on backlog prioritization and user story readiness.
• Managed Jira dashboards, sprint metrics, and delivery reporting to provide visibility into progress, risks,
dependencies, and release readiness.
• Supported business walkthroughs, sprint demos, user validation activities, and stakeholder communication
across the end-to-end delivery lifecycle.
• Contributed to team onboarding, engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives, helping strengthen
Agile ways of working and team collaboration.
Environment: Jira, Confluence, Java, Spring Boot, ReactJS, REST APIs, Oracle, Git, Jenkins, Postman, TOSCA

projects.name: Global Services Platform
projects.client: HSBC | Domain: Retail Banking | Duration: Jan 2016 – Sep 2018
details: • Led the Move Money and HK FPS Agile POD as Scrum Master, delivering functionality for real-time 24x7
payments and retail banking services.

• Facilitated Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews / Demos, Retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums to support sprint execution and release alignment.
• Supported requirement analysis, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and stakeholder reporting across
business and technology teams.
• Managed Jira / Confluence delivery artifacts, sprint metrics, and Agile reporting to improve delivery governance,
transparency, and progress visibility.
• Removed delivery impediments and supported team onboarding, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration
to strengthen Agile ways of working within the POD.
Environment: RTC, Quality Center, Jira, Confluence, Git, Jenkins, Maven, Postman, REST Client
